analysis.explanation: The observed timing mismatch between the Patient Records system and the model suggests a potential issue with the dependency assumptions. Specifically, the delay minutes for the authentication dependency to the Patient Records system may need review.

hypotheses.title: Review authentication dependency delay minutes
hypotheses.reason: The observed timing mismatch may be due to an overly optimistic delay assumption for the authentication dependency to the Patient Records system.

proposed_changes.title: Test the modeled dependency timing
proposed_changes.reason: Reality differed from the prediction for patient-records. Test the existing authentication → patient-records delay assumption without treating it as a proven cause.
